question: Europeans entered India with a mindset of trading only. This streak was initiated by which of the following European nations?
solution:
The correct answer is **Portuguese ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Portuguese **were the pioneering** European nation** to initiate trade with India, marking the onset of **European colonialism** in the subcontinent.
 
• Driven by a desire to dominate the** lucrative spice trade**, they established trading posts and fortified settlements along the Indian coastline.
 
• This interaction catalyzed cultural exchanges, triggered conflicts with indigenous rulers, and contributed to the transformation of Indian society.
 
• The Portuguese influence served as a precursor to centuries of European involvement and colonial governance in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Europe**, a continent situated predominantly in the **Eastern Hemisphere **and entirely in the **Northern Hemisphere**, is bounded by the Arctic Ocean to the north, the Atlantic Ocean to the west, the Mediterranean Sea to the south, and Asia to the east.
 
• It shares the landmass of Eurasia with Asia and forms part of Afro-Eurasia with both Asia and Africa.
 
• The watershed of the Ural Mountains, the Ural River, the Caspian Sea, the Greater Caucasus, the Black Sea, and the Bosporus Strait are commonly regarded as the dividing line between Europe and Asia.
 
• European culture comprises a diverse array of national and regional cultures, which collectively contribute to the broader Western civilization.
 
• Ancient Greece and ancient Rome, particularly through their Christian legacies, are widely acknowledged as pivotal and shared cultural influences throughout Europe.
